observations.expected: Customer, agent and administrator sessions permit their declared capabilities with protected identity.
A customer cannot self-promote or submit internal visibility, assignee, SLA override or other privileged ticket fields.
Restart/replay preserves valid sessions without reviving logged-out sessions or cross-application authority.
Current organization/group memberships permit the declared ticket reads and eligible assignment.
Foreign/inaccessible direct ticket/group identities are denied without data disclosure.
Scoped lists/counts omit unauthorized tickets and memberships before pagination.
Cross-scope or unauthorized assignment cannot change ticket/group/assignee state.
Retried commands recheck current persisted membership after revocation rather than trusting old request context.
Authorized create persists one ticket with one initial public article atomically.
Unauthorized customer/scope and privileged initial fields are rejected with no partial ticket/article.
Failure before article insert leaves neither record; lost committed response retry returns one ticket and conversation entry.
Authorized agents write public replies/internal notes with immutable author/time; customers see public replies only.
Customers cannot read internal note text through article detail, ticket/conversation history or export projections.
Customers cannot read internal note attachment metadata or bytes.
Internal note text/snippets/counts are absent from customer search projections, including stale indexes.
Queued/retried customer notifications and email payloads never include internal note text or attachment references.
An authorized expectedVersion command assigns/reassigns an eligible current group agent.
Revoked membership and ineligible/foreign assignees are rejected without assignment mutation.
Two assignments using one version produce one winner and one next version; stale concurrent assignment conflicts.
Allowed resolve/reopen/pending/close transitions maintain the declared article/deadline/audit consistency.
Forbidden transitions, including closed-to-open in core, reject without state changes.
Failure/racing stale transition leaves ticket, article, deadline and audit in one consistent committed state.
A 120-business-minute Friday 16:00 start is Monday 10:00, or Tuesday 10:00 with Monday a holiday, under the frozen calendar.
Exact UTC deadlines follow the immutable America/Chicago calendar; repeated fall-back time counts twice and missing spring time contributes nothing.
Internal notes/pending do not stop first response; only an authorized public agent reply stops it; closing cancels without marking met.
Calendar/SLA edits do not change existing deadlines; restart/replay preserves their exact versioned UTC result and reopen creates no implicit clock.
A currently due, unmet deadline produces its declared escalation and durable effects.
Cancelled/satisfied or stale-version deadline jobs cannot escalate; transaction rechecks current state before commit.
Worker restart, overdue catch-up and duplicate claims produce one logical escalation per deadline version in bounded batches.
Declared finite conditions/actions execute with explicit priority and first/all-match semantics.
Rules cannot grant access or mutate unauthorized/unknown fields and cannot execute arbitrary scripts.
Repeated/cascading matches are bounded and deduplicated with audit; restart cannot create an endless loop.
Authorized article/ticket uploads pass bounded inspection and can be associated/downloaded under parent visibility.
Foreign or customer access to internal-note metadata/bytes is denied, including previously issued byte references.
Oversized/disallowed MIME and incomplete/quarantined files are unavailable for association/download.
Interrupted bytes/metadata persistence exposes no partial private file and permits bounded orphan cleanup without deleting a live association.
Authorized ticket search, cursor pages and audit reads use current policy before projections/counts.
Customer search/audit outputs never contain internal note text or hidden snippets/counts.
After group revocation/move, stale search projections, cursor pages and audit reads do not disclose the now-inaccessible group/ticket.
Eligible customers/agents receive their selected channel and redacted durable inbox/delivery intent.
Unauthorized recipients, internal-note customer projections and another principal's preferences are rejected/hidden.
Duplicate delivery/worker restart preserves one logical inbox effect and revocation recheck prevents queued private disclosure.
Authenticated inbound MIME yields bounded body/attachment candidates and verified sender identity mapping.
Invalid source, oversized/unsafe attachments and unauthorized sender/ticket mappings are rejected.
Duplicate source message and interrupted ingest preserve one conversation effect with explicit unknown/recovery outcomes.
Authorized threading/merge/split preserves conversation history, visibility and provenance.
Ambiguous message references, inaccessible ticket sets and stale versions require rejection/explicit decision.
Interrupted/repeated conversation operations recover without duplicate articles, lost provenance or widened visibility.
Selected response/resolution policies explicitly define create/pause/resume/reopen/recalculate over immutable timeline facts.
Unauthorized recalculation or invalid policy/version cannot rewrite elapsed facts/deadlines.
Repeated/interrupted recalculation preserves one explicit versioned decision without silently changing historical clocks.
Verified external source and typed mapping produce the declared local customer command/provenance.
Forged source, cross-organization identity and conflicting field authority are rejected or explicitly reconciled.
Duplicate/out-of-order revisions and interrupted synchronization preserve one effect and an inspectable reconciliation item.
Authorized publication exposes the declared content revision to its selected audience and search projection.
Draft/private content is absent from public detail/search/snippets and cannot be published without authority.
Retried publication and search rebuild preserve revision identity/current audience without resurrecting withdrawn content.
Versioned typed custom fields and finite conditional actions implement the selected domain workflow.
Unknown/invalid values and executable strings or unauthorized actions are rejected.
Repeated/interrupted workflow execution is bounded, version checked and deduplicated without an unbounded rule cascade.
Authorized export/erase yields a bounded plan with retention/hold reasons and progress identity.
Customer export excludes internal notes and unauthorized organization data; erase cannot bypass holds/audit authority.
Interrupted/repeated execution resumes safely and cancels disallowed delivery without disclosing erased/internal content.
Authorized bounded metrics use explicit business-time and reopened-ticket counting definitions.
Reports cannot disclose unauthorized groups/internal notes or accept free-form SQL/unbounded windows.
Repeated/rebuilt reporting over the same versioned timeline preserves declared counts and exact business-time meaning.
